{{Otheruses|Squill}}
The '''Squill Sifters''' were a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]], [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] and codebreakers active during the [[Waymancy Storm]] of [[7811 BBY]]. During the war with [[Waymancy Hollow]], they worked to intercept and analyze Waymancy communications.

One of the Squill Sifters was the [[Nagratha's mother|mother]] of the future [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], [[Nagratha]]. On the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm|Twenty-Fifth Anniversary]] of the end of the conflict, Nagratha gave a commemorative speech and singled out the Squill Sifters for their contribution to the Republic's victory.
